definitions.gloss: lessons, classes taken as a hobby or for personal development
definitions.explanation: Regular lessons or classes taken outside of school or work, typically as a hobby or for self-improvement. Includes activities like piano, swimming, calligraphy, martial arts, and similar pursuits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{習|なら}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To have one's child take lessons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{習|なら}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My daughter takes piano and swimming lessons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{習|なら}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気分転換|きぶんてんかん}→気分転換：08691_kibuntenkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: Starting a new hobby class as an adult is a nice change of pace and enjoyable.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common word in conversations about children's activities and adult hobbies. In Japan, it is typical for children to have multiple {習|なら}い{事|ごと} (piano, ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧, swimming, English, etc.) alongside school. Adults also use this word for hobby classes they attend regularly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {習|なら}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take lessons
- {習|なら}い{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める: to start taking lessons
- {習|なら}い{事|ごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to attend lessons regularly
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{習|なら}い{事|ごと}: popular extracurricular activities
